summary_en: Cypress Holdings announced a share buyback program. Specific terms including acquisition amount, share quantity, percentage of outstanding shares, price ceiling, acquisition period, and method are not disclosed in the provided excerpt.
title_en: Supplementary Explanatory Material on Share Offering and Treasury Stock Acquisition
translation_en_brief: On November 4, 2026, Cypress Holdings Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard, code 428A) disclosed supplementary material regarding a share offering and treasury stock acquisition program. However, the provided excerpt contains only the disclaimer and cover page of the disclosure document, and does not include the substantive terms of the buyback program. To obtain specific information regarding the acquisition amount in yen, number of shares to be acquired, acquisition price ceiling, percentage relative to outstanding shares, acquisition method (such as ToSTNeT-3 or open market purchase), and acquisition period, the complete disclosure document or prospectus must be reviewed.
